body.x: INTERPOL is the world’s largest international police organization, with 196 Member Countries. Created in 1923, it facilitates cross-border police co-operation, and supports and assists all organizations, authorities, and services whose mission is to prevent or combat international crime.

INTERPOL actively encourages applications from women and nationals of member countries that are currently unrepresented among our staff (please click on this link to access the list of countries). Candidates from these countries are particularly encouraged to apply.
INTERPOL’s recruitment process is merit-based hence all hiring decisions are made considering the applicant’s qualifications and the needs of the Organization.

Only professional experience for which candidates can provide official proof of employment will be considered. Candidates could be requested to provide copies of such official documents prior to interviews/test.
* Subsequent extension to this post will be subject to the terms of the Organization’s Staff Manual, to satisfactory performance and to availability of funds.

* This position is financed by a third-party, external to the Organization with funding provided by the donor. Although there is a commitment from the donor, the appointment may be terminated prior to indicate official end date of project, should the external funding for this position no longer be available. This position also carries, in principle, no expectation of renewal. Any potential subsequent extension will be subject to the terms of the Organization’s Staff Manual, to satisfactory performance and to availability of funds.

OR.* This position has a temporary nature and carries, in principle, no expectation of renewal. Any potential subsequent extension will be subject to the terms of the Organization’s Staff Manual, to satisfactory performance and to availability of funds.

Tests/interviews in connection to this selection procedure will take place approximately xx weeks after the deadline for applications. Applicants are kindly requested to plan their availability during this period accordingly, in case they are short-listed.
Selected candidates will be expected to report for duty approximately two to three months after receiving an offer of employment at the latest.
This selection exercise may be used to generate a reserve list of suitable candidates that may be used to address Organization's similar staffing needs in the future.
SUMMARY OF THE ASSIGNED DUTIES, INCLUDING GOALS AND OBJECTIVES OF THE POST
The IT Product Manager is responsible for the end-to-end lifecycle and value delivery of specific digital products within a Tribe.

Operating within an autonomous Product Squad, the incumbent owns the product vision, roadmap, and backlog of a product portfolio, serving as the bridge between business strategy and technical execution. The IT Product Manager ensures the product delivers continuous, measurable operational impact by leveraging shared Platform Engineering capabilities, and actively pushing AI and Data integration to enhance INTERPOL’s capabilities.
Define and communicate a clear product vision and strategy aligned with the Tribe’s objectives and INTERPOL’s IT Strategic Framework for their product portfolio.
Translate high-level business goals into a concrete Product Roadmap.
Conduct continuous discovery (user research, data analysis) to identify user needs and validate hypotheses before build.
Prioritize features based on business value, ROI, and operational urgency, ensuring the team builds "the right thing."
Act as the primary Product Owner for the Squad: create, maintain, and prioritize the Product Backlog.
Draft clear, actionable User Stories with defined Acceptance Criteria.

Collaborate daily with the Squad (Developers, DevOps and Platform Engineers, Solution Architects, Scrum Master…) to ensure roadmap feasibility, align business requirements and make rapid trade-off decisions.
Participate actively in Agile rituals, ensuring a consistent flow of delivery.
Define and follow Service Level Agreements (SLAs) and KPIs (e.g., uptime, response time) to ensure the product meets business requirements.
Prioritize technical debt and maintenance alongside new features in the backlog to ensure long-term stability ("You build it, you run it" philosophy).
Analyze support tickets and user feedback to identify recurring issues and drive permanent fixes.
Define, measure, and continuously track specific business value metrics and Key Results to ensure the product delivers tangible operational impact for end-users.
Conduct regular Return on Investment (ROI) assessments, balancing the realized business value against the total cost of ownership.

In partnership with the Contract Manager, oversee the product's financial health: forecast and track operational costs (licensing, infrastructure, resources, support contracts…) and align with procurement procedures.
Evaluate "Buy vs. Build" scenarios to ensure cost-effective delivery of capabilities.
Identify high-value opportunities to integrate AI and Machine Learning features (e.g., predictive analytics, natural language processing) into the product.
Collaborate with the AI Acceleration Lead to prototype and validate AI use cases rapidly.
Ensure the product generates and utilizes high-quality data, adhering to INTERPOL’s Data Governance standards.
Act as the main voice of the customer; manage expectations of diverse stakeholders (General Secretariat, Member Countries, NCBs).
Lead product demos and manage the feedback loop to iterate on the product.
Oversee the change management and training strategy to ensure successful product adoption by end-users.
Perform any other duties as required by the supervisor.
Three to four years’ education at a University or specialized higher education establishment.
Certifications in Product Management (e.g., CPO, PSPO) or Agile (e.g., CSM, SAFe) are highly desirable.
At least five years of experience in Digital Product Management (managing the full lifecycle from discovery to launch).
Proven experience working in Agile/Scrum environments with cross-functional technical teams.
Desirable: Experience in integrating AI/ML features into existing workflows.
Desirable: Experience in Law Enforcement, Government, or highly regulated sectors.
Fluency in English is required. Proficiency in a second official working language of the Organization (Arabic, French or Spanish) would be an additional asset.
Strong communication skills, both in written and oral form (public speaking, leading meetings and delivery of presentations).
Product Mindset: Focus on delivering value and outcomes rather than just outputs.
Commercial Acumen: Ability to manage budgets and vendor relationships effectively.
Tech-Savvy: Sufficient understanding of modern software concepts (APIs, Cloud, AI) to communicate effectively with the Solution Architect and Engineers.
Leadership: Ability to lead and motivate a squad without formal HR authority (servant leadership).
Communication: Excellent storytelling skills to articulate the "Why" behind product decisions to senior leadership.
Cultural Awareness: Ability to work in a massively multicultural environment.
Domain Knowledge: Knowledge of the law enforcement/police domain would be an advantage.
As part of our commitment to transparency throughout our recruitment process, INTERPOL's Staff Manual Regulation 11.4: Age-limit, which states that:

'Officials of the Organization shall not normally be retained in service beyond the age of 65 years. The Secretary General may, in exceptional cases and in the interests of the Organization, extend this age limit, in which case he shall inform the official concerned sufficiently in advance.'

Given this Regulation and in case candidates reach the age of 65 during the potential duration of the appointment, should they be selected for the position and the process proceed to appointment, the employment period may be affected by this regulatory limit and may therefore not extend for the full standard contract duration as published in the vacancy notice.
We are sharing this information to ensure transparency at this stage of the process.
This position is no longer open.
